summary.en: Maya Joint has reached the quarter-finals of the Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo, beating Spain's Cristina Bucsa 6-1, 2-6, 6-4 in the round of 16 after recovering from 3-1 down in the deciding set. The 20-year-old Australian qualifier, ranked No. 94, had already knocked out sixth seed Sorana Cirstea and will now face Kamilla Rakhimova, who beat Ekaterina Alexandrova in a near three-hour marathon. In the night match, eighth seed Alexandra Eala rallied past Australia's Talia Gibson 4-6, 6-2, 6-0 to also reach the last eight.
summary.zh_hans: 东京泛太平洋公开赛 16 强，澳洲外围赛球手 Joint 以 6:1、2:6、6:4 击败西班牙的 Bucsa，决胜盘一度落后 1:3 之下反胜，晋级八强。这位 20 岁、世界排名 94 位的球手之前已淘汰 6 号种子 Cirstea，八强将对 Rakhimova，后者以接近三小时的马拉松战击败 Alexandrova。晚场赛事，8 号种子 Eala 以 4:6、6:2、6:0 反胜澳洲的 Gibson，同样打入八强。
summary.zh_hant: 東京泛太平洋公開賽 16 強，澳洲外圍賽球手 Joint 以 6:1、2:6、6:4 擊敗西班牙的 Bucsa，決勝盤一度落後 1:3 之下反勝，晉級八強。這位 20 歲、世界排名 94 位的球手之前已淘汰 6 號種子 Cirstea，八強將對 Rakhimova，後者以接近三小時的馬拉松戰擊敗 Alexandrova。晚場賽事，8 號種子 Eala 以 4:6、6:2、6:0 反勝澳洲的 Gibson，同樣打入八強。

summary.en: Liverpool beat Chelsea 6-5 on penalties after a 1-1 draw in normal time in the fourth round of the English League Cup at Anfield, booking a place in the quarter-finals. Chelsea took the lead through a Morgan Rogers penalty in the 40th minute, but Cody Gakpo equalised from the spot just three minutes later. In the shootout both sides missed kicks before goalkeeper Giorgi Mamardashvili made a crucial save and Joe Gomez scored the decisive penalty.
summary.zh_hans: 英格兰联赛杯第四圈，利物浦主场与切尔西在法定时间踢成 1:1，互射十二码以 6:5 胜出晋级八强。切尔西由摩根·罗杰斯（Morgan Rogers）在 40 分钟射入十二码先开纪录，利物浦仅三分钟后由加普（Cody Gakpo）同样凭十二码扳平。互射十二码阶段双方多次失手，利物浦门将马马达殊维利（Giorgi Mamardashvili）救出关键一球，祖·高美斯（Joe Gomez）射入制胜一球，为红军锁定胜局。
summary.zh_hant: 英格蘭聯賽盃第四圈，利物浦主場與車路士在法定時間踢成 1:1，互射十二碼以 6:5 勝出晉級八強。車路士由摩根·羅傑斯（Morgan Rogers）在 40 分鐘射入十二碼先開紀錄，利物浦僅三分鐘後由加普（Cody Gakpo）同樣憑十二碼扳平。互射十二碼階段雙方多次失手，利物浦門將馬馬達殊維利（Giorgi Mamardashvili）救出關鍵一球，祖·高美斯（Joe Gomez）射入制勝一球，為紅軍鎖定勝局。

summary.en: The Toronto Blue Jays beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 6-1 in Game 5 of the World Series at Dodger Stadium, taking a 3-2 series lead and moving within one win of their first championship since 1993. Davis Schneider and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. opened the game with back-to-back home runs off Blake Snell, the first time in World Series history a game has begun with consecutive long balls. Rookie Trey Yesavage struck out 12 over seven innings, a World Series rookie record, allowing just three hits and one run as the series shifts back to Toronto for Game 6.
summary.zh_hans: 多伦多蓝鸟在世界大赛第五场作客以 6:1 大胜洛杉矶道奇，系列赛领先 3:2，只要再赢一场就能夺得自 1993 年以来首个总冠军。戴维斯·施奈德（Davis Schneider）与小弗拉迪米尔·古里路（Vladimir Guerrero Jr.）开赛即先后轰出全垒打，是世界大赛史上首次有球队以连续两支全垒打开局。新秀投手耶萨维奇（Trey Yesavage）主投七局三振 12 次，创下世界大赛新秀纪录，只失 3 支安打及 1 分；系列赛将返回多伦多进行第六场。
summary.zh_hant: 多倫多藍鳥在世界大賽第五場作客以 6:1 大勝洛杉磯道奇，系列賽領先 3:2，只要再贏一場就能奪得自 1993 年以來首個總冠軍。戴維斯·施奈德（Davis Schneider）與小弗拉迪米爾·古里路（Vladimir Guerrero Jr.）開賽即先後轟出全壘打，是世界大賽史上首次有球隊以連續兩支全壘打開局。新秀投手耶薩維奇（Trey Yesavage）主投七局三振 12 次，創下世界大賽新秀紀錄，只失 3 支安打及 1 分；系列賽將返回多倫多進行第六場。

title.en: Blue Jays crush Dodgers 6-1 in World Series Game 5 to move one win from title

summary.en: The Houston Rockets stayed undefeated at 5-0 with a commanding 132-100 win over the Milwaukee Bucks at Fiserv Forum, leading 57-35 at half-time and never looking back. Fred VanVleet scored 24 points, including 15 in the third quarter, while Kevin Durant added 18 as six Rockets finished in double figures despite missing centre Alperen Sengun. Tyler Herro led Milwaukee with 23 points, but the Bucks fell to 1-4 as their other starters combined for just 12 points.
summary.zh_hans: 侯斯顿火箭作客以 132:100 大胜密尔沃基雄鹿，开季五连胜保持不败，半场已领先 57:35，之后未曾受过威胁。范弗利特（Fred VanVleet）攻入全队最高 24 分，其中 15 分来自第三节，杜兰特（Kevin Durant）贡献 18 分；火箭在缺少中锋森根（Alperen Sengun）下仍有六人得分上双。雄鹿由希罗（Tyler Herro）攻入 23 分领军，但其他首发合共只得 12 分，球队跌至 1 胜 4 负。
summary.zh_hant: 侯斯頓火箭作客以 132:100 大勝密爾沃基公鹿，開季五連勝保持不敗，半場已領先 57:35，之後未曾受過威脅。雲維利特（Fred VanVleet）攻入全隊最高 24 分，其中 15 分來自第三節，杜蘭特（Kevin Durant）貢獻 18 分；火箭在缺少中鋒森根（Alperen Sengun）下仍有六人得分上雙。公鹿由希路（Tyler Herro）攻入 23 分領軍，但其他正選合共只得 12 分，球隊跌至 1 勝 4 負。

summary.en: Stephen Curry scored a season-high 44 points as the Golden State Warriors held on for a 119-114 road win over the Minnesota Timberwolves on Wednesday, their second straight victory. Curry shot 11-of-27 with a perfect 16-of-16 from the line, adding eight rebounds and six assists. It was his 15th career 40-point game after turning 35, tying LeBron James for the most all-time. The Timberwolves, missing Anthony Edwards after knee surgery, lost their second in a row.
summary.zh_hans: 史提芬·居里周三作客明尼苏达狂轰今季新高 44 分，率领金州勇士以 119:114 险胜木狼，取得两连胜。居里 27 投 11 中、罚球 16 罚全中，另加 8 篮板 6 助攻。这是他 35 岁后第 15 次单场取得 40 分或以上，追平勒邦·占士保持的历史纪录。木狼缺少因膝部手术预料缺阵约两个月的安东尼·爱德华兹，遭遇两连败。
summary.zh_hant: 史提芬·居里周三作客明尼蘇達狂轟今季新高 44 分，率領金州勇士以 119:114 險勝木狼，取得兩連勝。居里 27 投 11 中、罰球 16 罰全中，另加 8 籃板 6 助攻。這是他 35 歲後第 15 次單場取得 40 分或以上，追平勒邦·占士保持的歷史紀錄。木狼缺少因膝部手術預料缺陣約兩個月的安東尼·愛德華茲，遭遇兩連敗。

summary.en: The Li-Ning Hong Kong Open Badminton Championships 2026 will be held at Kai Tak Arena from November 17 to 22, the first time the tournament moves to the new world-class venue. As an HSBC BWF World Tour Super 500 event with US$500,000 in prize money, 280 players from 30 countries and regions have qualified, including world champion Alex Lanier, world No. 1 Christo Popov and women's world No. 3 Wang Zhiyi. Hong Kong will field 11 home players — five men and six women — including Lee Cheuk Yiu, Ng Ka Long and Tse Ying Suet. Association chairman Tang Wai-lun also announced Hong Kong has secured hosting rights for Super 750 events from 2027 to 2030.
summary.zh_hans: “李宁二零二六香港公开羽毛球锦标赛”将于 11 月 17 至 22 日首度移师启德体艺馆举行，属汇丰世界羽联世界巡回赛超级 500 分站，总奖金 50 万美元，280 名来自 30 个国家及地区的球手入围，包括世锦赛冠军兰尼亚、“世一”波波夫、女单“世三”王祉怡等。港队派出 5 男 6 女共 11 人主场作战，包括李卓耀、伍家朗、吴英伦及谢影雪等。羽总会长汤伟伦宣布，已成功争取 2027 至 2030 年超级 750 赛事主办权。
summary.zh_hant: 「李寧二零二六香港公開羽毛球錦標賽」將於 11 月 17 至 22 日首度移師啟德體藝館舉行，屬滙豐世界羽聯世界巡迴賽超級 500 分站，總獎金 50 萬美元，280 名來自 30 個國家及地區的球手入圍，包括世錦賽冠軍蘭尼亞、「世一」波波夫、女單「世三」王祉怡等。港隊派出 5 男 6 女共 11 人主場作戰，包括李卓耀、伍家朗、吳英倫及謝影雪等。羽總會長湯偉倫宣布，已成功爭取 2027 至 2030 年超級 750 賽事主辦權。

summary.en: Hong Kong tennis No. 1 Coleman Wong continued his fine form at the ATP 125 Seoul Challenger, needing only 58 minutes to beat 22-year-old Greek Stefanos Sakellaridis 6-1, 6-3 and storm into the quarter-finals. The world No. 87 dominated throughout, dropping just one game in the first set before closing out the second. Wong will next face Japan's seventh seed Sho Shimabukuro in a rematch of last year's final, aiming to avenge three straight defeats and chase his second career ATP Challenger title.

summary.en: Nikola Jokic recorded his 200th career regular-season triple-double as the Denver Nuggets beat the New Orleans Pelicans 104-91 on the road. The three-time MVP finished with 21 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists, becoming only the second player in NBA history to reach 200 triple-doubles after the retired Russell Westbrook (209). Jamal Murray led Denver with 23 points and Aaron Gordon added 15 points and 11 rebounds. The Nuggets moved to 2-2 with both wins coming against the Pelicans, who fell to 0-4 despite Zion Williamson's game-high 25 points.

summary.en: Tai Po's AFC Champions League Two campaign is all but over after a 0-3 home defeat to Thailand's BG Pathum United in their Group F third-round tie. The visitors struck three times before the break — Bissoli opening the scoring in the 27th minute, a second five minutes later, and Radulovic racing clear to make it 3-0 just before half-time. There were no further goals after the restart. In the group's other game, Lion City Sailors won 2-0 away to Adelaide United to move top with seven points, while Tai Po sit bottom with zero points from three matches.

summary.en: Jalen Brunson scored 38 points with seven assists as the New York Knicks came back from 19 points down to beat the Chicago Bulls 133-127 on the road. Coach Mike Brown benched the struggling Mikal Bridges for almost the entire second half, riding reserves Tyler Kolek, Jordan Clarkson and Landry Shamet, who combined for 41 points and 15 assists. Karl-Anthony Towns added 19 points and 13 rebounds despite a first-half hand scare. Norman Powell led Chicago with 30 points.

summary.en: Victor Wembanyama scored 36 points with 14 rebounds and five assists as the San Antonio Spurs beat the Utah Jazz 117-111 in overtime in Salt Lake City. The French star rediscovered his touch on both ends of the floor after a slow start to the season, hitting contested jumpers and protecting the rim down the stretch. Keyonte George led Utah with 31 points. The Spurs return home to face the Minnesota Timberwolves on Halloween night.
